system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you have two [Throwing] weapons equipped to your [Hand Slots]. Your [Attack Power] is the sum of the two weapons and your Range is equal to the lowest range of the two.

(SR2): Gain +2 [Accuracy].
(SR3): Your "Shadowless Kick" becomes [Range: 1 Sq].

A fighting style that uses thrown weapons with both hands and fires continuously.
